mapper.select: SELECT diet_id FROM community_post_diet WHERE post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY diet_id ASC

SELECT d.id AS dietId, d.date AS date, d.meal_type AS mealType, d.description AS description, d.image_url AS imageUrl, d.total_kcal AS totalKcal, d.total_carbohydrate AS totalCarbo, d.total_protein AS totalProtein, d.total_fat AS totalFat FROM community_post_diet pd JOIN diet d ON pd.diet_id = d.id WHERE pd.post_id = #{postId} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.date DESC
